subject.title: Support compat reasoning levels for thinking xhigh

question: Should OpenClaw accept `supportedReasoningEfforts` and `reasoningEffortMap` as the generic OpenAI-compatible Completions and Responses contract for exposing and sending extended reasoning efforts?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and tested, but provider/plugin API behavior and upgrade-visible model capability exposure need maintainer/provider-owner intent before merge.

options.title: Accept Expanded Compat Contract
options.body: Land this PR as the intended contract for explicitly configured OpenAI-compatible Completions and Responses models.

options.title: Narrow To Completions Only
options.body: Ask the author to remove or defer Responses compat support if maintainers are not ready to bless that surface.

options.title: Choose A Different Provider API
options.body: Pause this PR if extended efforts should be expressed through a provider profile or plugin API instead of compat metadata.

recommendation.title: Accept Expanded Compat Contract
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the intended contract for explicitly configured OpenAI-compatible Completions and Responses models.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the earlier configured-xhigh compat work and appears in current history for the shared helper/docs surface this PR extends.
